better_answer_example: As a computing student, I'm excited about the data analyst role because it combines my passion for working with data and solving problems. Although I faced challenges, such as debugging code and ensuring data accuracy, I was able to learn and grow from the experience. I believe this role will allow me to further develop my skills and apply them to drive business insights.
